offer-check.title: OfferCheck
offer-check.task: O06: Verify release usability and prepare a permitted quote-comparison trial
offer-check.verdict: O01–O05 are accepted in Foundry. Fresh make check passed 52 backend tests, Ruff and mypy; Chromium passed all 3 browser tests. The independent review supports the bounded local technical MVP, with manual field/source capture and EUR fixed-pack comparisons. No real comparison benefit has been demonstrated.
offer-check.reads: docs/mvp/RELEASE.md, docs/checkpoints/O05.md, docs/OPERATIONS.md, docs/api/WORKFLOW.md, acceptance/ and examples/agent_client.py
offer-check.verify: Run make check and uv run pytest -m browser. Replay a new request and two offers, field/source review, comparison, decision, stale-after-edit/expiry, restart and isolated backup/restore. Check outsider access, agent versus reviewer authority, unsupported prices and source retention. Inspect the receipt at 390px: the current receipt is a long evidence inventory; the review result must remain easy to find. Review upload/capture manually, because the core replay starts with seeded quotes.
offer-check.next: Prepare a permitted same-task comparison against a competent spreadsheet/template and the operator’s usual agent. Create a small runnable, synthetic rehearsal pack and a blank trial record with identical inputs, setup/review/correction times, material misses, unknown terms and operator interventions. Preserve missing terms as unknown and explicitly label rehearsal rows synthetic. Fix only demonstrated capture/review/receipt friction with before/after browser evidence; keep exact calculation and reviewer boundaries. Deliver a one-page local operator walkthrough and unsent tester request that identifies the exact redacted input needed.
offer-check.accept: Independent acceptance matrix and reproducible checks; synthetic comparison rehearsal runnable without Foundry; baseline and app use identical source terms; real trial records remain blank until permitted inputs exist; any UX repair has a reproducer and green regression; no purchasing or supplier contact.
offer-check.gate: Next real gate: owner-authorized redacted purchase request and supplier quote set, with a designated reviewer. Measure correctness and effort before proposing OCR, integrations, currencies or procurement expansion. Repeated useful comparisons may justify one input integration; if a spreadsheet/agent performs as well with less effort, simplify or stop.
offer-check.commands:
make check
uv run pytest -m browser

volley-match.title: Volley Match
volley-match.task: V06: Audit organizer workflow and prepare two private-session trials
volley-match.verdict: V01–V05 are accepted in Foundry. Fresh make check passed Ruff, strict mypy and 41 tests. Actual Chromium replay passed at 1280px and 390px, including opponent confirmations, correction of the first match, rating history and restart. PostgreSQL and independent wheel evidence were retained by the implementing agent; this coordinator reran SQLite and browser checks.
volley-match.reads: docs/RELEASE.md, docs/evidence/MVP_ACCEPTANCE.md, docs/IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md, acceptance/cases.json, docs/pilot/DECISIONS.md and OBSERVATION_SHEET.md
volley-match.verify: Run make check and the browser replay with a new VOLLEY_EVIDENCE_PREFIX. Rehearse as an organizer and separate player accounts: invite revocation, full-session join, guest claim, opponent-only confirmation, dispute, backdated correction and deletion. Check that ratings remain scoped to group/format and that an organizer can explain provisional ratings without developer assistance. Reuse retained PostgreSQL evidence unless a new change touches SQL/transactions; then rerun the isolated PostgreSQL harness.
volley-match.next: Turn the existing two-session pilot sheets into an executable organizer rehearsal: fresh synthetic group, minimal organizer checklist, participant instructions, completion/error counters and an empty observation record for actual sessions. Fix only blockers found in the unaided invite/join/score/confirm flow. Keep invite drafts unsent. Define raw denominators for joins, confirmations without developer intervention, disputes, time-to-confirm and voluntary reuse after session two.
volley-match.accept: Fresh core checks and browser replay pass; six separate synthetic actors complete the whole organizer flow; account deletion preserves appropriate historical records without retaining private identity; a reproducible local rehearsal and two-session observation packet exist; real adoption rows remain empty.
volley-match.gate: Next real gate: a willing private group and an explicitly approved access arrangement. Success means participants can operate their own accounts and voluntarily reuse the app across two sessions. If confirmation or onboarding fails, simplify it first. Team balancing/tournaments require demonstrated reuse; public matchmaking remains conditional.
volley-match.commands:
make check
VOLLEY_EVIDENCE_PREFIX=next-review-UNIQUE uv run python tests/browser/replay.py

crous-queue.title: Crous Queue
crous-queue.task: Q06: Audit honest wait states and rehearse a five-lunch pilot
crous-queue.verdict: Q01–Q05 are accepted in Foundry. Fresh make check passed lint, formatting, types and 17 backend tests; all 6 actual browser tests passed. The app delivers the national directory and recent-report workflow. This is a directory-backed local MVP, with no evidence yet of live reporting coverage or returning contributors.
crous-queue.reads: docs/IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md, docs/OPERATIONS.md, docs/PILOT.md, docs/DEPLOYMENT_PROPOSAL.md, scripts/check_pilot.py and ../../foundry/requests/2026-10-06-crous.md
crous-queue.verify: Run make check and CQ_EVIDENCE_PREFIX=next-review-UNIQUE uv run pytest tests/browser. Verify the 972-row retained snapshot, separate Cuvier/Châtelet/cafeteria IDs, malformed-region last-good data, unknown versus zero versus conflicting waits, exact 15-minute expiry, same-device replacement, offline lost-response retry, moderation and retention. Review service-worker/cache behavior after a release and restart. Treat source observations as dated; do not claim the directory is current without a new permitted read-only refresh.
crous-queue.next: Rehearse the existing five-lunch measurement workflow against a disposable synthetic store. Add only missing measurement/diagnostic support actually revealed by the rehearsal. Produce an operator schedule and blank local records for fixed checks at the two selected sites; count planned checks, actual checks, fresh estimates, unknown/conflicting states, distinct-day device reuse and contribution friction separately. Include a missing-check example that stays missing. Confirm queue categories through the existing R011 request when an ordinary voluntary visit is available; preserve user replies.
crous-queue.accept: Full checks and mobile/offline/moderation flows pass; measurement output includes explicit numerator/denominator and missingness; synthetic and real environments cannot be mixed; demo backup/restore and expiry remain correct; no synthetic waits enter a real feed; release proposal remains a concrete unapproved payload.
crous-queue.gate: Next real gate: five ordinary lunch days with voluntary own observations at Cuvier/Châtelet and an approved private access arrangement. No strangers’ identities/photos/traces. If fresh contributions remain sparse, test a bounded distribution approach after approval; do not add fictitious wait prediction. National venue coverage does not imply national live data.
crous-queue.commands:
make check
CQ_EVIDENCE_PREFIX=next-review-UNIQUE uv run pytest tests/browser

volley-coach.title: Volley Coach
volley-coach.task: C06: Audit scheduling usability and prepare a two-week own-program trial
volley-coach.verdict: C01–C05 are accepted in Foundry. Fresh make check passed Ruff, strict mypy and 31 backend tests; both Chromium tests passed. This supports the independent scheduling MVP in user-provided-program mode. It does not establish the quality of app-authored physical instructions or training outcomes.
volley-coach.reads: docs/RELEASE.md, docs/PILOT.md, docs/PRIVACY.md, docs/IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md, docs/adr/0004-user-scoped-session-logs.md and evidence/C05/
volley-coach.verify: Run make check and the two browser flows with a unique VOLLEY_BROWSER_EVIDENCE path. Rehearse onboarding with an empty catalog and a user-provided program, timezone/DST ambiguity, unavailable court/partner, replan, immutable completed history, shared program IDs across two accounts, discomfort hold and reject/undo adjustment. Verify private export, deletion, restart and isolated restore. Review language/readability with the intended participant; default English is not evidence of user fit.
volley-coach.next: Prepare a reproducible two-week scheduling rehearsal using programs already chosen by the participant/coach, with synthetic slots and cancellations for local testing. Extend existing pilot notes only where needed to capture feasibility, skip reasons, replanning effort, actual reuse and reported usefulness. Fix demonstrated onboarding/resource-entry friction with browser evidence. Deliver a simple local walkthrough, an empty consented-trial sheet and a clear mode label showing that user-provided programs are not professionally reviewed by this app.
volley-coach.accept: Full checks and browser flows pass; every assigned session fits its recorded resources/time; completed history survives cancellation/replanning; two users cannot collide on logs; synthetic scheduling rehearsal is repeatable; real participant observations remain blank and no unreviewed app-authored instruction is introduced.
volley-coach.gate: Next real gate: consenting adult participant(s) bringing an existing program for two weeks. Measure scheduling usefulness and reuse, not physiological improvement. App-authored exercise guidance requires qualified content review/permission. Match Elo integration, video analysis and automatic coaching remain conditional.
volley-coach.commands:
make check
VOLLEY_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=.local/browser-next-review-UNIQUE uv run pytest tests/browser

coopain.title: Coopain
coopain.task: Recover and complete J03, then J04 and J05 in dependency order
coopain.verdict: J01 and J02 are accepted. J03 is still in progress and has substantial unaccepted changes. A fresh coordinator run of the current tree passed 171 backend tests with three warnings, using the existing Python 3.12 J03 environment. The retained earlier J03 log reports 170 tests; retain both dated runs. No coordinator frontend/browser or clean-install certification was performed. MVP completion is not yet established.
coopain.reads: docs/mvp/IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md, docs/mvp/DEPENDENCY_INVENTORY.md, .foundry/runs/j03/, backend/requirements.lock, frontend lock/configuration, backend/tests/test_mvp_j03_*.py and your existing worktree/delegate reports
coopain.verify: Inventory git status, retained J03 diffs, existing tests, migrations and any unfinished worktree contributions before editing. Do not overwrite earlier results or reapply integrated patches. Reproduce the backend suite from the lock in a fresh disposable environment, then frontend unit tests, lint, types and build. Reconcile Python 3.11 J01 documentation versus the current J03 Python 3.12 environment. Audit additive migration of a populated synthetic legacy database, auth/token/CSRF/rate limits, upload-disable behavior, grant revocation, export/deletion and error redaction.
coopain.next: Finish the accepted J03 contract and submit its evidence to Foundry before advancing. Then execute J04 actual desktop/390px candidate and referrer flows, including withdrawn/blocked/deleted profiles, restart and clean setup. Finish J05 with a concrete private release decision, rights/employer-policy/privacy checklist, unsent tester drafts and employer/community payer experiment preparation. Preserve historical matches and never reset an existing app database. The host message “failed to load workspace requirements” is not evidence of a Foundry defect; the repo and Foundry state were readable in this review.
coopain.accept: J03 is accepted only with reproducible dependency/migration/auth/privacy evidence; J04 has real browser evidence and no developer-only shortcuts; J05 identifies exact unresolved rights/privacy/policy inputs while producing a complete local demo. No candidate fees, real referrals, real sends or deployment are authorized.
coopain.gate: After local MVP completion, one willing candidate/referrer/job workflow can test useful introductions and referrer effort once access, rights and policy facts are settled. Later test employer/community payer interest. Record fact-specific unknowns for review; do not claim legal clearance from generic notes.

PYTHONPATH=backend /tmp/coopain-j03-security-venv/bin/python -m pytest backend/tests -q -o addopts=''

ride-options.title: Ride Options
ride-options.task: Finish active R05, verify the release, then prepare the real planning comparison
ride-options.verdict: Point-in-time review: R01–R04 are accepted; R05 is in progress. The coordinator did not rerun this actively changing application or alter its claim. Retained R04 evidence reports ten frozen regional requests, six with feasible options, 58 regional routing warnings and missing manual Kurviger/rider judgments. Synthetic access cases do not satisfy the regional road-use gate. Refresh these facts from your final R05 records before relying on them.
ride-options.reads: docs/mvp/QUALITY_PROTOCOL.md, QUALITY_REPORT.md, PENDING_TRIALS.md, docs/IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md, experiments/quality-queries.json, evidence/r04/ and current R05 artifacts
ride-options.verify: Finish your current R05 checkpoint first. Audit the original acceptance row against the narrowed local-preview release wording: explicitly mark regional road-use and missing comparator/rider evidence unresolved. Verify current make check, TypeScript build, browser A–B/loop/via/save/reload, geometry-preserving GPX, resource bounds, isolated recovery and a clean offline recorded-fixture install. Do not claim a full road-ready release because a planning-preview release passed.
ride-options.next: After R05, create a bounded R06 only if no equivalent continuation exists. Inventory the regional import warnings and classify which selected routes are affected or unknown; retain reproduction and exact extract/engine/profile hashes. Prepare five planning trial records using the same user preferences in this app and Kurviger: options, hard-constraint failures, elapsed planning time, manual edits, rejected routes and rider preference. Perform the permitted manual read-only comparison only if an interactive browser is available and access is allowed; otherwise leave fields null with a concrete operator task. Distinguish maximum-duration from target-duration loops; measure whether the 4–5h request actually produces useful options before changing generation.
ride-options.accept: R05 scope and unmet original gates are explicit; standalone checks and GPX inspection pass; warning inventory and route-level consequences are retained; recorded fixture results and real-engine results stay separate; comparator/rider fields contain actual observations or null; no road-use safety claim from synthetic fixtures.
ride-options.gate: Next real gate: user preference judgments on actual planning tasks plus manual comparison. Road use separately requires regional restriction/warning review and selected-route checks; current openness is never guaranteed. Prefer a provider/adapter correction or a narrower area if semantics cannot be demonstrated. Wider geography, social ratings and imagery wait for measured utility and appropriate access.
ride-options.commands:
make check
make test-browser
# Run the current documented TypeScript and offline fixture checks as well.
